quantity: Placebo-subtracted change in the Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ), in points (0-100, higher is better), per drug class and ejection-fraction band. A trial average, not a prediction for one patient.
method: Collected, then independently re-read and resolved by fixed rules (docs/symptom-evidence-2026-11-15/). One estimate per class and band. MLHFQ results are converted through the standardized mean difference and marked extrapolated. A class with no measurement is filled from the nearest band, then a sibling class, then assumed neutral, then not measured (value 0); the basis says which.

rows.population: Val-HeFT HFrEF; n=3010
rows.quote: Valsartan had a significant beneficial effect on the least-square mean change in overall MLWHF score from baseline to study endpoint (+/- standard error) (average followup 23.0 months) compared with placebo (0.19 +/- 0.47 versus 1.94 +/- 0.48; P = .005 respectively).

rows.notes: Interval is computed, not published; the reported P=0.005 implies a slightly narrower one. Add-on to ACEi/beta-blocker background; mean follow-up 23 months.
